title: OpenCode turnstile configuration
description: Schema for ~/.config/opencode/turnstile.json. Every key is optional and falls back to the code defaults in src/config.ts; a missing key is never an error. The $schema key itself is ignored at load when it is a string (a non-string warns); it is the editor convention pointing at this file. Markers and regex sources (gateMarker, verdictMarker, evidencePattern, the toolPolicy/gitGates regex lists, commitFormat) are strings; evidencePattern, the denylists, and commitFormat are compile-checked at merge time and compiled at setup, gateMarker/verdictMarker compile at setup with a journaled fallback on a bad source — none are validated here.

$schema.description: Editor convention pointing at this file; ignored at load when a string (not a turnstile key).

metricsDir.description: Directory for both telemetry files; must be an absolute path (not expanded). Computed at load time when omitted.

journalMaxBytes.description: Rotate a journal file past this many bytes (default 5242880).

journalMaxGenerations.description: Number of rotated journal generations to keep (default 5).

replayTailLines.description: Journal lines replayed per boot, walked newest-first across all retained generations, stopping early once the bound is met (default 2000).

maxTotalDispatches.description: Total task/subagent dispatches per task, the global loop backstop (default 16).

agentMarkerRetry.description: Compliance re-prompts per bare-output child delivery (no GATE/VERDICT marker) before it counts a violation; 0 disables the retry (default 1).

readWarn.description: Whole-file read count at which the horizon warning is injected (default 8).

readBlock.description: Whole-file read count at which further reads are blocked (default 15).

observeSessions.description: Number of admitted parent sessions that run in observe mode (decisions journaled, nothing blocked) before enforcement switches on (default 0).

waiverMarker.description: Literal marker that, appearing in the user's OWN prompt, waives gates: unscoped (no agent names in the words) it covers every gate; naming configured agent stages scopes it to those stages' gates (default USER WAIVER:).

approvalMarker.description: Literal prompt-channel plan-approval marker (default PLAN APPROVED:).

plansDir.description: Project-relative directory scanned for ## Decomposition plans (default .opencode/plans).

trace.description: Write the human-readable trace file (JSONL journal always writes) (default true).

continuationCarry.description: Carry the task's gate flags across a prompt reset when the worktree/branch is unchanged, instead of starting a clean cycle (default true).

suspendMarker.description: Literal marker that, appearing in the user's own prompt, suspends gate blocking for the session (decisions keep journaling, nothing blocks; state cleared fresh) (default TURNSTILE OFF:). Never agent-dispatchable; ignored when allowSuspend is false.

resumeMarker.description: Literal marker that, appearing in the user's own prompt, resumes enforcement with fresh task state — no credit earned while suspended survives (default TURNSTILE ON:). Never agent-dispatchable.

taskDoneMarker.description: Literal marker that, appearing in the user's own prompt, explicitly retires the session's active task: journals {type:"task-complete", plan} with the bucket's activePlan and stamps taskComplete, so the next admitted prompt starts a fresh task scope (default TASK DONE:). Admission-only: child results and dispatch prompts never retire a task.

allowSuspend.description: Whether the suspend/resume markers are honored; false refuses both the OFF and ON markers (journaled refused:true entry and a surfaced diagnostic; no state change) (default true).

intentNudge.description: Advisory intent nudge: a user prompt classified as implementation intent (work verb at code, issue reference, plan-file reference, or plan-dispatch request) with no plan approval journals {type:"intent"} and prepends one advisory pipeline-entry nudge to the next tool delivery; false is a full no-op (default true).

escalation.description: Repeat-attempt escalation mode for the landing and hands-on gates: block (default) re-throws the block with no permission ask — release is waiver/approval-marker or earned reviewer verdict only; ask arms a one-shot latch and forces the host permission ask (collapses to allow under auto-accepting hosts).

sessionSummary.description: Session-end summary surface: quiet (default) prints one recap line at session.idle for sessions that did something (silent for zero-activity sessions); on also prints an all-gates-green line for zero-activity sessions; off disables the surface entirely.

agents.description: Agent names turnstile recognizes in dispatches.

bareOutput.description: Agents contracted to emit GATE/VERDICT markers (unset by default; an absent, omitted, or empty value derives from the configured test-runner, reviewer, and plan-reviewer names — JSON cannot express the code's unset sentinel, so an empty list is read as unset).

gateMarker.description: Gate marker regex source, compiled with gm.

verdictMarker.description: Verdict marker regex source, compiled with gm.

gateEvidence.description: Evidence-correlation mode for the reviewer gate (default enforce).

reviewEnsemble.description: Enforcement mode for the reviewer ensemble (default enforce).

evidencePattern.description: Case-insensitive regex source matched against bash/shell commands to count as test-execution evidence.

toolPolicy.description: Denylist policy for bash/shell and write/edit tools in execute.before.

bashDeny.description: Case-insensitive regex sources matched against bash/shell commands (default empty).

pathDeny.description: Case-insensitive regex sources matched against write/edit target paths (default empty).

observeSessionMove.description: Journal session_move dispatches as telemetry (default true).

bashWriteGate.description: Gate confident file-writing bash commands (redirects from writer commands, tee, sed -i/--in-place, cp/mv/dd/truncate/touch) through the parent hands-on ladder (default true); write-shaped commands always journal handsOn telemetry.

gitGates.description: Git-and-commit gate configuration (commitMessages and landingGate default true).

commitMessages.description: Whether git commit messages are linted as conventional commits (default true).

commitFormat.description: Conventional-commit regex source (compiled ^...$ with s) matched against each subject.

landingGate.description: Whether pushing/PR-landing is gated on a reviewer VERDICT: APPROVE (default true).

emptyDiffExempt.description: Whether a statically-provable empty-diff git push (every refspec ref-equal to its upstream; no force flags) skips the landing gate (default true; false is the strict opt-out).
